objective: Run the current nine-partition schedule without proximity or pair expansion, then compare every literal partition union with the same schedule using the three previously tested trailing-wildcard population atoms.

controls.native_ris: not used in this diagnostic stable-ID comparison
controls.literal_A1_exception: The 2770-character literal A1 is retained as the historically accepted comparison baseline. Every other submitted cell is at most 2700 characters.

current_compound_blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
current_compound_blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

cell_plan.A2: Lossless union of P AND E_F AND M_H and P AND E_F AND M_B. All other partitions use one direct expression.

wildcard_candidate.acceptance_rule: Adopt the candidate for every partition only if each complete wildcard union retains every literal stable ID, repeated event passes agree, and any wildcard-only records remain within the intended population meaning.
wildcard_candidate.preference_rule: Prefer the shorter wildcard rendering after the acceptance rule passes.

acceptance_checks: Every event has exact source query, date, route, page, and active-tab readback.
Every event completes two identical ordered DOI passes from page zero.
Every event saves one Advanced Search PNG and one first-results PNG beside its JSON.
A2 literal and wildcard unions include both predeclared branches.
Each wildcard partition union contains its complete literal partition union.
Every wildcard-only record is inspected against the population meaning.
No language, type-facet, access, vocabulary, proximity, or result-driven restriction is used.
